metadata.description: Caption Checker: check SRT and WebVTT captions against Netflix, BBC and DCMP Captioning Key limits.

plugins.name: caption-checker
plugins.description: MCP server with two tools: check_captions (reading speed, line length, lines, time on screen, gaps and overlaps against Netflix, BBC or DCMP) and list_standards (each limit and its source). Works offline, no key.
